purpose.summary: This is a core component of the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt (claims processing) software for Japan. It handles medical treatment act (診療行為) input processing, including patient insurance information, prescription sets, drug/procedure entry, and various billing calculations. It is a large, long-lived production program with an extensive revision history spanning 2000–2018.
